newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINA OUTPLAY U.S. TO WIN 2-1 IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA OUTPLAY U.S. TO WIN 2-1 IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: An early goal by veteran forward Hao Haidong set China on their way to a 2-1 win over the United States in a soccer friendly in the southwestern city of Kunming on Wednesday.
Hao darted through a gap in the U.S. defence to score in the 11th minute.
Teenage defender Li Tie added the second in the 30th minute after a perfect pass from Hao.
China continued to keep up the pressure in the second half but failed to breach the U.S. defence again.

Eric Wynalda, who played in the 1990 and 1994 World Cups, scored a fine solo goal for the Americans in the 73rd minute. He dribbled past several defenders before beating Chinese goalkeeper Ou Chuliang with a close-range shot.
The two sides meet again in the southern city of Guangzhou on February 1.
